parole.significato: A person who traces his/her ancestry to Fuzhou or the surrounding region.
parole.testo: From the Postal Romanization of Mandarin 福州 (Fúzhōu). Doublet of Hokchiu.

parole.testo: From the Postal Romanization of the Nanjing court dialect Mandarin 福建 (Fújiàn), from before the modern palatalization of [k] to [t͡ɕ]. Doublet of Hokkien. Compare Spanish Fokien, Portuguese Foquiem.
